resources.string: This deletes the saved list. The music in it is not deleted.
The station is removed from your stations. You can add it again later.
This track has nowhere to come back to
Set up %1$s to play its tracks in Andamp. Until then they are skipped.
Sign in to play your %1$s tracks in Andamp. Until then they are skipped.
Andamp has the %1$s permission. Tracks you add keep playing after a restart.
Without the %1$s permission, Andamp can still play files you pick, but they may stop working after a restart.
The %1$s permission is off. Files you pick still play for now, but they may stop working after a restart.
Andamp needs %1$s to play the songs on this phone.
Allow %1$s in Andamp\'s settings to play the songs on this phone.
That was another folder. The songs play only from the folder they were added from.
Andamp can no longer read this folder. Allow it again and its songs play as before.
Floating on top of other apps needs Android 11 or later.
Andamp needs permission to draw over other apps before it can float on top of them.
This preset could not be read
It loads, but draws only black while music plays
This preset could not be read: %1$s

Nothing from this source would play. It may need a different account or plan, or the connection to it has gone. Pressing play again tries once more. If it keeps happening, check the source\'s own settings.
The station stopped and could not be reached again, so the player has stopped too. The station may be off the air, or the connection may still be down. Pressing play tries again.
The connection to the music server went, and the server could not be reached again. The server may be down, or the connection may still be gone. Pressing play tries again.
Every track in this playlist comes from a source this phone cannot reach right now: it is not installed, or nobody is signed in to it. Each row says which.
Andamp loads classic Winamp skins (.wsz). Modern skins (.wal) can\'t be added in this version.
This file is too large to load as a skin.
This modern skin didn\'t load, so it wasn\'t added.
Andamp shows your last classic skin instead for now. This modern skin is tried again the next time Andamp starts. To stop that, pick another skin in Skins or remove this one in the Skin Browser.
“%1$s” is a Winamp modern skin. Modern skins are in beta. Turn them on and add this skin? Press and hold a modern skin to open Andamp\'s menu. You can turn modern skins off in Preferences > Player.
